posts.body:
BAY ESTATE — EOI OPENS TODAY
Nakheel | Island E, Dubai Islands

A current Nakheel/Dubai Holding Real Estate manager briefing opens EOI submissions at 10:00 AM GST on 25 September 2026. It identifies townhouses, attached villas, garden villas and villa plots.

Broker indications: AED 100,000 EOI; 3BR townhouses from AED 5.9m; 4BR townhouses from AED 6.9m; 4BR attached villas from AED 7.2m; 4BR garden villas from AED 10m; 60/40 payment and January 2031 handover. These commercial terms are broker-reported and remain unconfirmed by Nakheel.

Why it matters: Bay Estate has moved from advance reporting to a live EOI intake window for Nakheel's first residential release on Island E.
Confidence: high on project identity and EOI timing; medium-high on product mix; commercial terms unconfirmed.
